purpose: Teach: 一体化/つとめ/マネージメント/結集/少人数/樹立/取り込ん/交互

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究と教育を一体化させろ
lines.en: Ren — integrate your research with your teaching.
lines.style: Calm, measured directives. Each point lands with quiet authority. No rush. The confidence of someone who has seen this path before and knows where it leads.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。後輩の指導におつとめを果たします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to guide the junior researchers properly.
lines.style: Respectful but not obsequious. Steady voice — he's thought about this already. Slight forward lean in posture. Commitment without overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のマネージメントも学べ
lines.en: And learn how to manage the lab. That's part of it.
lines.style: Simple addition, not an afterthought. Slight emphasis on 「learn」 — he's naming something Ren needs to develop. Warm but clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究員の知見を結集して論文を出します
lines.en: Understood. I'll consolidate everyone's insights into publications.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underneath the formality. Not defensive — he's already thinking three moves ahead. Breath steady. Eye contact held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、少人数の研究ゼミから始めろ
lines.en: Start with a small seminar group. Build from there.
lines.style: Practical and unadorned. No theater. The efficiency of someone who values precision. Brief pause before the second sentence — let it land separately.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新研究分野の樹立を目指します
lines.en: Yes. We'll establish a new research direction through careful mentoring.
lines.style: Formal register kicks in slightly. Respectful pacing. The word 「careful」 carries weight — he's absorbed the constraint and elevated it to intention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外文献を取り込んで研究を深めろ
lines.en: Read the international literature. Let it deepen your perspective.
lines.style: Shift to something almost conversational — still directing, but now speaking to Ren as an emerging scholar. Slight warmth on 「deepen」.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究指導と現場仕事を交互におこないます
lines.en: Understood. I'll move between teaching and fieldwork, building both simultaneously.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Voice has gained solidity through the conversation. Not exhausted — settled. Small pause at the comma. Conviction without strain.
